DLG-SC-LOC-026-18-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-026-18-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 明日の朝食のお時間について、ご質問でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-18-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you have a question about breakfast time tomorrow?

DLG-SC-LOC-026-18-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-026-18-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 六時半には出発します。朝食は七時からと聞いたので、宿泊の予定にどう合わせればよいか相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-18-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 六時半出発と七時朝食開始の不一致を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-18-001-SHARED-02.translation: I am leaving by six thirty. I heard breakfast starts at seven, so I would like to discuss how to fit it into my stay.
DLG-SC-LOC-026-18-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Discuss the mismatch between leaving at six thirty and breakfast starting at seven. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-18-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-026-18-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 通常の会場は七時からです。早い出発の方へは、前日までに軽食の手配をご相談いただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-18-001-SHARED-03.translation: The regular breakfast venue opens at seven. Guests leaving early can discuss arranging a light meal by the day before.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-18-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-026-18-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 軽食を聞きたいです。列車の時間は変えられないので、会場の開店を早めてもらうより、持って出られる形が合います。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-18-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 列車変更不能のため会場早開けでなく持出軽食を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-18-001-SHARED-04.translation: I would like to ask about a light meal. I cannot change my train time, so something I can take with me would suit me better than asking you to open the venue earlier.
DLG-SC-LOC-026-18-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you cannot change the train time and prefer a takeaway light meal rather than an earlier venue opening. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-18-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-026-18-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ご用意できる内容と料金はこちらです。お受取りは、朝の受付になります。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-18-001-SHARED-05.translation: Here are the available options and prices. You can collect it from reception in the morning.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-18-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-026-18-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この内容でお願いします。六時に受付へ取りに来れば、荷物をまとめる時間も残せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-18-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 提示内容料金を受け六時受付受取で荷物準備時間を残す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-18-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will have this option, please. If I collect it from reception at six, I will still have time to get my luggage ready.
DLG-SC-LOC-026-18-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Accept the offered meal and price, and say that collection at reception at six will leave time to prepare your luggage. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-18-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-026-18-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 六時のお受取りをお受けします。お部屋の同行者も同じ予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-18-001-SHARED-07.translation: We can arrange collection at six. Does the person sharing your room have the same plans?

DLG-SC-LOC-026-18-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-026-18-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 同行者は七時の朝食へ行きます。早く出るのは私だけなので、軽食は一人分にします。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-18-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 同行者は通常朝食で本人だけ早出のため軽食一人分を指定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-18-001-SHARED-08.translation: My companion will go to breakfast at seven. I am the only one leaving early, so I will order the light meal for one person.
DLG-SC-LOC-026-18-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Specify one light meal because only you are leaving early, while your companion will have the regular breakfast. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-18-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-026-18-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 一人分で手配します。出発時のお手続きも受付で承れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-18-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will arrange one portion. You can also complete your departure procedures at reception.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-18-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-026-18-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 軽食を受け取る時に手続きも済ませます。二人の朝の予定を別々にできたので、同行者にはゆっくり食べてもらえます。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-18-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 受取時に出発手続も行い同行者は通常朝食を楽しめると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-18-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will complete the procedures when I collect the meal. Now that we can have separate morning plans, my companion can take their time over breakfast.
DLG-SC-LOC-026-18-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will complete departure procedures at collection and your companion can enjoy the regular breakfast. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-18-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-026-18-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 明朝六時にお待ちしております。それでは、今夜もゆっくりお休みください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-18-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will see you at six tomorrow morning. Have a restful night. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-19-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-026-19-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: コーヒーをお持ちしました。ごゆっくりどうぞ。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-19-001-SHARED-01.translation: Here is your coffee. Please enjoy your time here.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-19-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-026-19-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。旅の絵を描いています。もしよければ、あなたを少しモデルにして描いてもよいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-19-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 旅の絵として店員へ短いモデル協力の可否を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-19-001-SHARED-02.translation: Thank you. I am drawing pictures of my trip. If you do not mind, could I draw you as a model for a short while?
DLG-SC-LOC-026-19-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether the staff member can briefly pose as a model for a drawing of your trip. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-19-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-026-19-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今は仕事のため、モデルとして止まっている時間は取れません。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-19-001-SHARED-03.translation: I am working at the moment, so I cannot take time to stand still as a model.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-19-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-026-19-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 分かりました。今日はこのカップを描きます。仕事をする姿を勝手に追って描くより、自分の席で楽しめる物を選びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-19-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 業務中のモデル不可を受け自席カップへ描画対象を変える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-19-001-SHARED-04.translation: I understand. I will draw this cup today. Rather than following you as you work and drawing you without permission, I will choose something I can enjoy from my own seat.
DLG-SC-LOC-026-19-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Accept that the staff member cannot model during work and change your subject to the cup at your seat. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-19-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-026-19-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: お席での短いスケッチならご利用いただけます。紙はテーブルに収まりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-19-001-SHARED-05.translation: A brief sketch at your seat is fine. Does your paper fit on the table?

DLG-SC-LOC-026-19-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-026-19-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 小さいノートです。カップと紙を並べられます。飲む前の形を少し描き、コーヒーも楽しみたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-19-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 小ノートは卓上へ収まり描画と飲物を両方楽しみたいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-19-001-SHARED-06.translation: It is a small notebook. I can place the cup and paper side by side. I would like to sketch its shape a little before drinking, and enjoy the coffee too.
DLG-SC-LOC-026-19-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that your small notebook fits on the table and you want to enjoy both sketching and your drink. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-19-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-026-19-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 飲み物を置く場所を空けてお使いください。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-19-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please leave space for the drink as you use the table.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-19-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-026-19-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 紙を右へ寄せました。左のカップを見て、取っ手の形から描き始めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-19-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 紙を右飲物を左へ分けカップ取手から描くと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-19-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have moved the paper to the right. I will look at the cup on the left and start drawing the shape of its handle.
DLG-SC-LOC-026-19-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you placed the paper on the right and drink on the left and will start by drawing the cup's handle. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-19-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-026-19-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: できあがったら、旅の記念になりますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-19-001-SHARED-09.translation: Once it is finished, it will be a souvenir of your trip.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-19-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-026-19-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 一枚描けました。店員さんの肖像ではなく、この席で飲んだ一杯の記念です。絵をしまって、残りのコーヒーを味わいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-19-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 描画完成を店員肖像でなく一杯の記念と説明しノート収納後味わう。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-19-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have finished one drawing. It is a memento of the cup I had at this seat, rather than a portrait of a staff member. I will put the drawing away and savor the remaining coffee.
DLG-SC-LOC-026-19-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain that the finished drawing commemorates your coffee rather than portraying the staff member, and enjoy the drink after putting the notebook away. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-19-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-026-19-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご来店ありがとうございます。それでは、ごゆっくりお過ごしください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-19-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for visiting. Please relax and enjoy your time here. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-20-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-026-20-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 資材を移す準備は、できていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-20-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you ready to move the materials?

DLG-SC-LOC-026-20-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-026-20-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 場所は確認しました。ただ、この荷物を一人で持てる自信がありません。先ほど一人でやると答えましたが、手助けをお願いしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-20-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 一人運搬を引き受けたが不安があるため開始前に援助を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-20-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have checked the location. But I am not confident I can carry this load alone. I said earlier that I would do it alone, but I would like to ask for help.
DLG-SC-LOC-026-20-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that although you agreed to carry it alone, you feel unsure and want help before starting. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-20-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-026-20-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 始める前に話してくれてよかったです。今、その荷物は動かしていませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-20-001-SHARED-03.translation: I am glad you spoke up before starting. You have not moved that load yet, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-026-20-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-026-20-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだ元の場所です。先に一人で持ってから困るより、人数と使う方法を確認してから始めたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-20-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未移動を報告し担当人数方法を確認してから開始したいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-20-001-SHARED-04.translation: It is still in its original place. Rather than lifting it alone first and then getting into difficulty, I want to check how many people will handle it and what method to use before starting.
DLG-SC-LOC-026-20-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Report that it has not been moved and say that you want to check the number of people and method before starting. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-20-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-026-20-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 担当者と方法を確認します。待つ間は、隣の通路の整理をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-20-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will confirm who will handle it and how. While you wait, please tidy the neighboring passage.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-20-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-026-20-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 通路の整理へ移ります。運搬を助けてくれる方が決まったら、次の順番を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-20-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 運搬担当調整中は通路整理へ移り次順の案内を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-20-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will move on to tidying the passage. Once someone has been assigned to help with the carrying, please tell me the next steps.
DLG-SC-LOC-026-20-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will tidy the passage while the carrying assignment is arranged, and ask for guidance on the next steps. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-20-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-026-20-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 運搬を担当できる二人へ引き継ぎました。あなたには、整理後の経路を一緒に確認してもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-20-001-SHARED-07.translation: I have handed the carrying over to two people who can do it. You will help us check the route after it has been tidied.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-20-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-026-20-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 私は荷物を持つ役から、通路と経路を確認する役へ変わるのですね。その担当なら今から進められます。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-20-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 運搬担当二人と本人経路確認役への変更を理解しその役で進める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-20-001-SHARED-08.translation: So my role is changing from carrying the load to checking the passage and route. I can get started on that role now.
DLG-SC-LOC-026-20-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show that you understand two people will carry it and your role has changed to checking the route, and proceed in that role. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-20-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-026-20-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認した経路は、運搬担当へその場で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-20-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please tell the carrying team about the route you have checked while you are there.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-20-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-026-20-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 通路を片付けました。担当の二人と同じ経路を見て、通る場所を共有してから作業へつなぎます。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-20-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 整理完了を報告し担当二人と経路を共有して運搬へつなぐと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-20-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have cleared the passage. I will look at the same route with the two people assigned, make sure we share which way to go, and then move on to the carrying work.
DLG-SC-LOC-026-20-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Report that tidying is complete and say that you will share the route with the two assigned people before the carrying begins. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-20-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-026-20-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 助かりました。それでは、担当者と確認を進めてください。午後もよろしくお願いします。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-20-001-SHARED-11.translation: That was helpful. Please continue checking with the assigned team. Thank you for your work this afternoon as well. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-21-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-026-21-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お振込みのご相談でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-21-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to discuss a bank transfer?

DLG-SC-LOC-026-21-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-026-21-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人から生活を手伝ってほしいと言われました。私は貸す話かと思いましたが、返す予定までは聞いていません。振込む前に整理したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-21-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 友人援助依頼を本人は貸付と思ったが返却予定未確認と振込前に相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-21-001-SHARED-02.translation: A friend asked me to help with living expenses. I thought they meant a loan, but I have not asked about any repayment plans. I would like to clarify that before transferring money.
DLG-SC-LOC-026-21-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain before the transfer that you assumed your friend's request for help meant a loan, but repayment plans are unconfirmed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-21-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-026-21-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お二人の約束は、先にご本人同士でお確かめください。こちらでは、ご希望の取引方法を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-21-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please first check the agreement directly between the two of you. Here, we will confirm how you would like to carry out the transaction.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-21-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-026-21-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 私から友人へ聞きます。口座へ送るだけで返す約束まで決まると思わず、渡せる範囲も一緒に考えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-21-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 友人へ本人が連絡し振込自体で返済合意とせず提供可能範囲を考える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-21-001-SHARED-04.translation: I will ask my friend myself. I will not assume that sending money to the account establishes a repayment agreement, and I will also consider how much I can afford to give.
DLG-SC-LOC-026-21-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you will contact your friend yourself, not treat the transfer itself as a repayment agreement, and consider what you can afford to provide. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-21-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-026-21-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 連絡を終えてから、金額と振込先をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-21-001-SHARED-05.translation: After you have finished contacting them, please confirm the amount and recipient account.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-21-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-026-21-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 話せました。友人は借りるのでなく援助を希望していました。私が無理なく渡せる一万円だけ、今回送ると伝えました。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-21-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 友人の援助希望を確認し本人無理なし一万円の今回支援を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-21-001-SHARED-06.translation: We have spoken. My friend wanted support, not a loan. I said I would send just ten thousand yen this time, which I can give without difficulty.
DLG-SC-LOC-026-21-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you confirmed your friend wanted support and offered ten thousand yen this time within your means. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-21-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-026-21-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 本日は一万円のお振込みですね。毎月のご希望ではありませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-21-001-SHARED-07.translation: So today you would like to transfer ten thousand yen. You do not want to do this every month?

DLG-SC-LOC-026-21-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-026-21-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今回一回だけです。友人にも継続の約束ではないと話し、来月以降の分はまだ決めていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-21-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 一回のみで継続約束や来月分は未決定と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-21-001-SHARED-08.translation: Just this one time. I told my friend this is not a promise of continuing support, and we have not decided anything for next month onward.
DLG-SC-LOC-026-21-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that it is one time only, with no ongoing promise and no decision about next month. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-21-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-026-21-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 振込先の情報をお持ちになりましたら、担当へお話しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-21-001-SHARED-09.translation: When you have the recipient's account information, please speak to the staff in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-21-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-026-21-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 友人から送られた口座情報を持っています。金額と一回だけという希望が決まったので、取引の案内をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-21-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 受取口座情報を持参し決定済金額一回希望で取引案内を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-21-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have the account information my friend sent. Now that the amount and my wish for a one-time transfer are decided, please guide me through the transaction.
DLG-SC-LOC-026-21-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you have the recipient account information and request transaction guidance for the decided amount and one-time transfer. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-21-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-026-21-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。それでは、一万円のお振込みとして担当へご案内します。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-21-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I will direct you to the staff for a ten-thousand-yen transfer. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-027-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: どちらの列車をお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Which train are you looking for?

DLG-SC-LOC-027-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-027-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 次の特急です。乗る車両の番号が分からなくて、今はホームの端にいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 特急八号車の位置が不明だと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: The next limited express. I do not know where the car I am boarding is, and I am at the end of the platform now.
DLG-SC-LOC-027-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you do not know where car eight of the limited express is. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-027-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お持ちの券では八号車ですね。この列車は十二両です。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Your ticket is for car eight. This train has twelve cars.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-027-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 八号車の乗り口まで戻りたいです。足元の丸と三角のどちらを見ればいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 停車位置表示の形を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: I would like to go back to the boarding point for car eight. Should I look for the circles or triangles on the ground?
DLG-SC-LOC-027-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask which shape of stopping-position marker to follow. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-027-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 今回は三角の表示です。八と書かれた所へお進みください。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: For this train, use the triangle markers. Please go to the one marked eight.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-027-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 三角の八ですね。途中に階段がありますが、階段を降りずに行けますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 階段を使わず移動できるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Triangle eight, then. There are stairs along the way. Can I get there without going down them?
DLG-SC-LOC-027-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can get there without using the stairs. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-027-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、同じホームの中央寄りです。列車はまだ到着していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes, it is nearer the center of this same platform. The train has not arrived yet.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-027-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: それなら荷物を引いて歩いて行きます。車内で八号車へ移るより、先に乗り口へ行きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 乗車前に荷物と乗り口へ移ると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Then I will walk there pulling my luggage. I would rather go to the boarding point first than move to car eight inside the train.
DLG-SC-LOC-027-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will move to the boarding point with your luggage before boarding. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-027-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: あちらの三角の八が目印です。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: The triangle eight over there is your landmark.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-027-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 場所が見えました。券をしまって、あの表示の後ろに並びます。ありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 表示を発見し列へ並ぶと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I can see it now. I will put my ticket away and join the line behind that marker. Thank you.
DLG-SC-LOC-027-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you found the marker and will join the line. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-027-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: どうぞお気をつけて。よいご旅行を。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please take care. Have a good trip.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-027-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 展望の案内図をお配りしています。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: We are handing out view maps.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-027-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 川の方を見たいです。この図は、今立っている向きと同じですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 案内図の向きを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like to look toward the river. Does this map face the same direction as I am standing now?
DLG-SC-LOC-027-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about the orientation of the map. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-027-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今の向きに合わせるには、図を半回転させてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: To match the direction you are facing, please turn the map halfway around.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-027-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: こう回すのですね。川の線が二つありますが、手前の川はどちらですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 二つの川のうち手前を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: I turn it like this, then. There are two river lines. Which one is the nearer river?
DLG-SC-LOC-027-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish the nearer of the two rivers. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-027-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 太い線が手前です。窓の右側から見えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: The thick line is the nearer one. You can see it from the right side of the window.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-027-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 右へ移ってみます。建物が重なっているので、川の始まりを探す目印はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 川を見つける建物の目印を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will move to the right. The buildings overlap in the view. Is there a landmark to help me find where the river begins?
DLG-SC-LOC-027-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask for a building landmark to help find the river. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-027-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 白い橋を探すと、その下に川が見えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Look for the white bridge, and you will see the river beneath it.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-027-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 白い橋が見えました。向こうの細い線の川も同じ窓から見えるのですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 白い橋発見後遠い川の眺望を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I can see the white bridge. Can I see the farther river marked by the thin line from the same window too?
DLG-SC-LOC-027-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: After finding the white bridge, ask about the view of the farther river. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-027-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 遠い方は、この窓では建物の陰になります。反対側の案内板をご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: The farther one is hidden by buildings from this window. Please look at the information board on the opposite side.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-027-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 先に手前の川を見てから、反対側へ回ります。図もこの向きで持って行きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 手前を見て反対側へ回る順序を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will look at the nearer river first, then go around to the opposite side. I will keep the map facing this way as I take it with me.
DLG-SC-LOC-027-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to look at the nearer river first and then go to the opposite side. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-027-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: どうぞ景色をお楽しみください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please enjoy the view. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-027-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 散策地図はいかがですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like a walking map?

DLG-SC-LOC-027-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-027-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この辺りを歩きたいです。橋を二つ渡って、最後は今の場所へ戻れるコースはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 二つの橋を渡る周回を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like to walk around this area. Is there a route that crosses two bridges and returns to where we are now?
DLG-SC-LOC-027-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for a circular walk crossing two bridges. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-027-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この地図の青い線なら、一周して戻れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: The blue line on this map takes you around and back here.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-027-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 途中で川沿いへ下りる階段がありますね。今日は上の道だけで歩けますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 川沿い階段を避け上の道を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: There are stairs down to the riverside along the way. Can I stay on the upper path today?
DLG-SC-LOC-027-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you want the upper path and to avoid the riverside stairs. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-027-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。階段を下りず、次の橋までまっすぐ進んでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes. Do not go down the stairs; keep straight on to the next bridge.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-027-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 上の道にします。次の橋を渡ったら、右と左のどちらへ曲がりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 対岸で曲がる方向を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will take the upper path. After crossing the next bridge, do I turn right or left?
DLG-SC-LOC-027-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask which way to turn on the opposite bank. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-027-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 左です。川を左手に見ながら、こちらの橋へ戻ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Left. Walk back to this bridge with the river on your left.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-027-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 川がずっと左に見えるのですね。帰りにこの看板を近くで見られる場所も通りますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 帰路の看板を見る地点を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: So the river will stay on my left. On the way back, will I also pass somewhere I can see this sign close up?
DLG-SC-LOC-027-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask about the spot where you can see the sign on the return route. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-027-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 最後の橋の手前から見えます。地図に丸を付けますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: You can see it just before the final bridge. I will circle the spot on your map.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-027-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。青い線を一周して、丸の所で少し景色を見ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 地図線と丸印を使う散策計画を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I will follow the blue line around and stop at the circled spot to look at the scenery for a while.
DLG-SC-LOC-027-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Describe your walking plan using the line and circle on the map. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-027-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: よい散策を。足元にお気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Have a pleasant walk. Please watch your step.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-027-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 屋根の模型はこちらです。

DLG-SC-LOC-027-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-027-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 屋根の端の飾りを見たいです。この模型は回してもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 屋根飾りを見るため模型回転の可否を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like to see the ornaments at the ends of the roof. May I turn this model?
DLG-SC-LOC-027-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can rotate the model to see the roof ornaments. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-027-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 台の取っ手で回せます。模型本体には触れずにどうぞ。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: You can turn it using the handle on the base. Please do not touch the model itself.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-027-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 取っ手を使います。正面からは二つ見えますが、横からも見てみたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 取っ手操作を受け横側観察を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I will use the handle. I can see two from the front, but I would also like to look from the side.
DLG-SC-LOC-027-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Accept the instruction to use the handle and say that you want to observe the side. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-027-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ゆっくり半回転させると、反対側も見られます。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Turn it slowly halfway around and you can see the opposite side too.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-027-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 反対側にもありますね。写真に写すなら、飾りを近くで撮れる位置はどちらですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 反対側飾りを発見し撮影位置を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: There are some on the opposite side too. If I take a picture, where should I stand to photograph the ornaments close up?
DLG-SC-LOC-027-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you found ornaments on the opposite side and ask about a photo position. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-027-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらの低い側から撮ると見やすいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: They are easier to see if you take the picture from this lower side.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-027-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この位置なら形がよく見えます。模型の写真を一枚撮ってもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 低い位置で形を確認し撮影許可を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I can see the shapes clearly from here. May I take one photo of the model?
DLG-SC-LOC-027-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm the shapes from the lower position and ask permission to take a photo. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-027-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 撮影できます。見終わりましたら、取っ手を赤い印へ戻してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Photography is allowed. When you have finished looking, please return the handle to the red mark.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-027-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 写真を撮りました。赤い印へ戻したので、次は外から実物の屋根を探してみます。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 撮影後模型を赤印へ戻し実物を探すと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have taken the photo. I have returned it to the red mark, so next I will look for the actual roof from outside.
DLG-SC-LOC-027-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that after taking a photo you returned the model to the red mark and will look for the real roof. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-027-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: どうぞご見学をお楽しみください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please enjoy your visit. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-027-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 検査前のお話を伺います。記録をお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: I will ask you some questions before the test. Have you brought your records?

DLG-SC-LOC-027-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-027-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家で測った体温をノートに書いてきました。朝と夜の二回分があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 朝夜の体温ノートを提示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I wrote the temperatures I measured at home in a notebook. There are readings for twice a day, morning and evening.
DLG-SC-LOC-027-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Present your notebook of morning and evening temperature readings. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-027-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 日付と測った時間も書かれていますね。最近の分を見せてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: You have also recorded the dates and measurement times. Please show me the recent entries.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-027-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 直近の一週間はこのページです。数字の横の丸は、頭痛があった日です。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 直近ページと頭痛の丸印を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: The most recent week is on this page. The circles beside the numbers mark days when I had a headache.
DLG-SC-LOC-027-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain which page is the latest and what the headache circles mean. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-027-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 丸の意味も担当へ伝えます。飲んだ薬の記録はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will tell the staff what the circles mean as well. Do you have a record of the medicines you took?

DLG-SC-LOC-027-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-027-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 薬の名前は別の紙にあります。飲んだ時間はノートの下に書きました。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 薬名別紙と服用時間の位置を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: The medicine names are on a separate sheet. I wrote the times I took them at the bottom of the notebook page.
DLG-SC-LOC-027-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that the medicine names are on a separate sheet and where the dose times are written. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-027-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 二つを一緒に拝見します。説明しにくい所はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will look at both together. Is there anything that is difficult to explain?

DLG-SC-LOC-027-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-027-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 火曜だけ測った時間が違います。夜勤明けで、昼に測ったので、その点も伝えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 火曜の測定時刻が夜勤で違うと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: The measurement time is different only on Tuesday. I measured at midday after finishing a night shift, and I want to mention that too.
DLG-SC-LOC-027-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that Tuesday's measurement time differs because of your night shift. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-027-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 時間の違いを記録します。原本は診察でも使いますのでお手元へ戻します。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will record the difference in time. You will use the originals at your consultation too, so I will return them to you.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-027-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。診察では、この一週間のページと薬の紙を開いて説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 診察で開く資料二つを決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. At the consultation, I will open this week's page and the medicine sheet to explain.
DLG-SC-LOC-027-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide on the two records to open at the consultation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-027-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは担当へご案内します。お大事になさってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Now I will direct you to the staff in charge. Take care of yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-027-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご相談の内容を伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Please tell me what you would like to discuss.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-027-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 自転車置場の照明が消えていて、夜に鍵を開ける時に周りが見えません。防犯上気になります。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 暗い駐輪場の防犯相談を申し出る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: The lights in the bicycle parking area are off, and I cannot see around me when unlocking my bicycle at night. I am concerned about security.
DLG-SC-LOC-027-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask to discuss security concerns about the dark bicycle parking area. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-027-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どの場所で、いつ気づきましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Where is it, and when did you notice?

DLG-SC-LOC-027-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-027-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 自宅の集合住宅の裏です。三日前から、帰る時間の九時ごろは真っ暗です。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 場所と三日前からの帰宅時刻を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Behind the apartment building where I live. For the last three days, it has been pitch-black around nine when I get home.
DLG-SC-LOC-027-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the location and the conditions at your homecoming time since three days ago. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-027-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 建物の管理者には、もう伝えましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Have you already told the building manager?

DLG-SC-LOC-027-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-027-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今朝、修理をお願いしました。直るまで、明るい表の駐輪区画へ移せるかも相談しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 修理依頼と明るい区画への移動相談を話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I asked for repairs this morning. I am also discussing whether I can move my bicycle to the brightly lit parking section at the front until it is fixed.
DLG-SC-LOC-027-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Mention your repair request and discussion about moving to a brighter section. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-027-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 管理者との相談内容を伺いました。ほかに、気になる出来事はありましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: I understand what you have discussed with the manager. Has anything else happened that concerns you?

DLG-SC-LOC-027-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-027-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 物を取られたことはありません。先週、知らない人が中をのぞいていたので、その日時もメモしました。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 被害有無と不審な様子の日時メモを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Nothing has been stolen. Last week, someone I did not know was peering inside, so I also noted the date and time.
DLG-SC-LOC-027-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say whether there has been any loss and that you noted the date and time of suspicious behavior. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-027-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: そのメモも拝見します。場所が分かる図はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will look at that note too. Do you have a diagram showing the location?

DLG-SC-LOC-027-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-027-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: この図で、照明と入口に印を付けます。管理者に伝えたことも一緒に説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 図へ照明入口を記し相談経過を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will mark the lights and entrance on this diagram. I will also explain what I have told the manager.
DLG-SC-LOC-027-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Mark the lights and entrance on the diagram and describe the discussions so far. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-027-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。相談内容を確認します。それでは、お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I will check the details of your concern. Please take care.
